// CASE ts_plain_control expect=pass
export async function mapLimit<T>(items: T[], width: number, operation: (item: T) => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      await operation(items[index]);
    }
  }));
}

// CASE ts_trailing_comment expect=pass
export async function mapLimit2<T>(items: T[], width: number, operation: (item: T) => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      await operation(items[index]); // claimed slot
    }
  }));
}

// CASE ts_results_non_null expect=pass
export async function mapLimit3<T, R>(items: T[], width: number, operation: (item: T) => Promise<R>): Promise<R[]> {
  const results: R[] = new Array(items.length);
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      results[index] = await operation(items[index]!);
    }
  }));
  return results;
}

// CASE ts_extra_awaited_arg expect=fire
export async function mapLimit4<T>(items: T[], width: number, operation: (item: T, token: string) => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      await operation(items[index], await token());
    }
  }));
}

// CASE ts_awaited_inner_arg expect=fire
export async function mapLimit5<T>(items: T[], width: number, operation: (item: T) => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      await operation(await prepare(items[index]));
    }
  }));
}

// CASE ts_two_stmt_worker expect=fire
export async function mapLimit6<T>(items: T[], width: number, operation: (item: T) => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      await audit(index);
      await operation(items[index]);
    }
  }));
}

// CASE ts_width_one expect=fire
export async function serialWorker<T>(items: T[], operation: (item: T) => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: 1 }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      await operation(items[index]);
    }
  }));
}

// CASE ts_non_null_awaited_extra expect=fire
export async function mapLimit7<T>(items: T[], width: number, operation: (item: T, token: string) => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      await operation(items[index]!, await token());
    }
  }));
}

// CASE ts_nested_await_arg_expression expect=fire
export async function mapLimit8<T>(items: T[], width: number, operation: (item: T) => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      await operation(items[(await nextSlot()) ?? index]);
    }
  }));
}

// CASE ts_member_op expect=pass
export async function mapLimit9<T>(items: T[], width: number, client: { send(item: T): Promise<void> }): Promise<void> {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      await client.send(items[index]);
    }
  }));
}

// CASE ts_plain_loop_control expect=fire
export async function plain<T>(items: T[], operation: (item: T) => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
  for (const item of items) {
    await operation(item);
  }
}
